landing.heroTitle: Empowering Every Citizen Voice for Rapid
landing.heroSubtitle: Report local grievances in Tamil, English, or Hindi using voice notes, photos, or text. Our Gemini AI automatically routes, prioritizes, and tracks resolution progress.
landing.searchPlaceholder: Enter Complaint ID to check status...
landing.sectionFeaturesTitle: Designed for Citizens and Smart Governance
landing.sectionFeaturesSubtitle: End-to-end technology pipeline that translates spoken grievances into actionable, routed department tickets.
landing.featVoiceDesc: Express your grievance naturally in Tamil, Hindi, or English. Integrated Sarvam STT transcribes speech into clear data.
landing.featPhotoDesc: Upload photos of potholes, drainage leaks, or streetlights. Gemini Vision analyzes image content automatically.
landing.featClassDesc: AI evaluates severity scores (1-5), urgency levels, and disruption impact to prioritize urgent public safety risks.
landing.featRoutingDesc: Complaints are dispatched to the right agency (PWD, Water Board, Electricity Board, Sanitation) without manual delay.
landing.featTrackingDesc: Track the exact status of your complaint with a unique tracking ID from submission to review and resolution.
landing.featAuditDesc: Every stage update and official action is logged transparently in an immutable audit history for full accountability.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Simple 3-step process to get civic issues resolved fast.
landing.step1Desc: Record a voice note or type in Tamil, Hindi, or English. Attach a photo if available.
landing.step2Desc: Gemini AI classifies the issue, calculates urgency, and assigns the correct department ticket.
landing.step3Desc: Monitor status updates and officer progress online using your tracking ID.
landing.footerTagline: Empowering Citizens with Multilingual AI Technology.
